title: Belrose Circle Earning Rate Card
content:
# Belrose Circle Earning Rate Card

Each tier of the Belrose Circle Membership Programme earns points per dollar of qualifying spend at a rate fixed by the kind of spend, and fixes a ceiling on the points earned on one sale and on the balance held, whether points are earned on a sale that already carries a promotional discount, and how many double-earning events the member is offered in a membership year.

## Points per dollar of qualifying spend

| Tier | Merchandise | Custom commission | Workshop repair work | Protection plan | Appraisal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Circle Member | 1.0 | 1.0 | 0.5 | 0.5 | 0.0 |
| Belrose Circle Silver | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.0 | 0.5 | 0.5 |
| Belrose Circle Gold | 2.0 | 2.5 | 1.0 | 1.0 | 0.5 |
| Belrose Circle Platinum | 2.5 | 3.0 | 1.5 | 1.0 | 1.0 |
| Belrose Circle Black | 3.0 | 4.0 | 2.0 | 1.5 | 1.0 |
| Belrose Circle Founders' Club | 4.0 | 5.0 | 2.5 | 2.0 | 1.5 |

The rate is read by tier and by kind of spend together; the five kinds carry five rates at each tier, and a Belrose Circle Member earns 0.0 points per dollar on an appraisal while earning 1.0 point per dollar on merchandise.

## Ceilings, promotional stacking and double-earning events

| Tier | Most points earned on one sale | Most points held on the balance | Points earned on a sale already carrying a promotional discount | Double-earning events offered per membership year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Circle Member | 50000 | 250000 | No | 1 |
| Belrose Circle Silver | 75000 | 400000 | No | 2 |
| Belrose Circle Gold | 125000 | 750000 | Yes | 3 |
| Belrose Circle Platinum | 250000 | 1500000 | Yes | 4 |
| Belrose Circle Black | 500000 | 3000000 | Yes | 6 |
| Belrose Circle Founders' Club | 2000000 | 10000000 | Yes | 12 |

## Rate card reading (hypothetical)

- Merchandise rung for a Belrose Circle Platinum member is rated at 2.5 points per dollar; the same merchandise rung for a Belrose Circle Silver member is rated at 1.5 points per dollar.
- Workshop repair work is rated at 0.5 points per dollar for a Belrose Circle Member and 2.5 points per dollar for a Belrose Circle Founders' Club member.
- A sale carrying a promotional discount is rated at the tier's rate for a Belrose Circle Gold, Belrose Circle Platinum, Belrose Circle Black or Belrose Circle Founders' Club member; at Belrose Circle Member and Belrose Circle Silver the card shows No against promotional stacking.
- The ceiling on one sale for Belrose Circle Black is 500000 points and the ceiling on the balance is 3000000 points.
